bindings.detail: This template calls a separate workflow named lib: Post-Process Metrics, and it is included in your download as lib/lib-post-process-metrics.json. Import that file into n8n first (Workflows -> Import from File), then open Offload to Post-Process Sub-workflow and pick it in the workflowId selector. The selector is empty until you do: a workflow id only exists inside your own instance, so it cannot be set for you.

behaviour.title: Set a real fallback for the placeholder expressions
behaviour.detail: "OPS_CHAT_ID" appears as the fallback branch of an expression. When the upstream field is missing the expression does not fail - it resolves to that literal string and the call is made with it, which reads downstream as a malformed value rather than as missing data.

behaviour.title: Point the HTTP calls at your own endpoint
behaviour.detail: The URLs "enrichment.example.com", "news.example.com" are illustrative - example.com is reserved for documentation and resolves to nothing useful. Replace them with the service you are actually calling, and set that service's authentication on the node.

behaviour.title: Clear the pinned sample data before going live
behaviour.detail: "Daily Schedule" carries pinned sample data, which is what lets the workflow run end to end before you have wired anything up. While it is pinned, a manual execution reads the sample and never calls the real service - so the run succeeds and proves nothing about your setup. Unpin it once the credentials and bindings are in place.
